mcqs.question: Under the ‘Super GST – Super Savings’ awareness programme conducted by the Andhra Pradesh Fisheries Department at Narendrapuram village, what GST rate change was highlighted for key fisheries items?
mcqs.explanation: GST on key fisheries items was reduced from 12% to 5%. The 5% to 12% option reverses the direction of the cut; 1.50% refers to the power subsidy per unit, not the revised GST rate.
